features.name: FullBleedLayout
features.description: supportsFullBleed flag in manifest allowing seamless placement in full-width modern SharePoint section columns.

features.name: DualLayoutModes
features.description: Toggle dynamically between Tabbed View (pill/underline) and Accordion View (collapsible panels).

features.name: ChildContentBlocks
features.description: Configurable child content slots supporting Rich Cards, Embed/iFrame tools, British Metric Stats (£), and Quick Links.

features.name: FluentUI2DesignSystem
features.description: Built 100% on Microsoft Fluent UI 2 (@fluentui/react-components) with native SharePoint theme inheritance, Griffel tokens, and dark/light adaptive surfaces.

features.name: PropertyPaneCustomisation
features.description: Comprehensive 3-page interactive SharePoint properties sidebar for configuring layout, sections, badges (Core, Real-time, Interactive, etc.), British financial metrics (£), cards, and presets in Edit Mode.

features.name: InlineCanvasAndCardEditing
features.description: Direct WYSIWYG in-place editing for container title, subtitle, card titles, descriptions, and metrics on the canvas in Edit Mode, paired with contextual floating card action toolbars.
